text: After your first sign-in, do these six things once. The Before your first order list on your console shows what is left.

text: Fill in firm name, GST, PAN, bank and UPI ID, then tap Save Business Profile.

markup: अब, [pause short] Add my first store दबाएँ।

text: Now tap Add my first store.

text: Keep I will run this store myself ticked. Fill in name, city, area and location, and tap Create Store.

text: Tap Stock and Products at the top, then Menu, then Add Product.

text: Type the fruit's name, like aam or kiwi, and tap it in the Fruitify list.

text: Name, category and unit fill in by themselves. Type your price.

text: Add your own photo of the fruit; Fruitify checks it first. Then tap Add Product.

text: Choose each product's GST rate, ask your CA, and tap Save GST Rates.

text: In the Stock and Products menu, open Send Stock to a Store. Choose product and quantity, and send.
